content: Mẹ wọ, Isaak oyeri Jekọb ọsẹ-ẹ ittabọhng, ọtzọr-ẹ itzọhng, oben-ẹ bi, “Kwanọng kpenamkpen kw'ofon m'ẹkhọma cha Kenaan kàtzọkha o.
Kọ rọhng ka Padan-Aram atza atzokha kwanọng k'obhon k'echimma cha Bẹtuẹl, kw'ode otte kw'akka, k'ottem kw'aminava p'agbaanakka kw'akka, kw'ode Laban.
Tte Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ẹfa biphyir, ọdọ-ọ ttara va k'ọhaabh, obiro osi va pa va pọ bẹ ahaabh maa, bẹ an-asi ngọma sa nhaabh-ọhaabh.
Tte kẹ ọnang kọ ọmaana va pa va pọ ẹdaa ch'iwa ọnangi Abraham, ifha kọ afha atzọkha irerek nna s'arukhi mẹ mach'okhekhennọng, irerek nna s'iwa Ibinọkpaabyi ọnangi Abraham.”
Mẹ wọ, Isaak ọtzọhm Jekọb, ochina ka Padan-Aram, okhebha Laban kw'ode nnwa kwa Bẹtuẹl kw'ofon Aram, kw'obiro ode ọgbaanọkka kwa Rẹbẹka, kw'ode ọkka kwa Jekọb ọmaana Ẹsau.
Ẹsau ọtzọk kwanọng ọdọdọk
Mada Ẹsau orong bi, otte kwabẹ Isaak, okk'Jekọb ittabọhng ọsa, obiro ọtzọhm-ẹ bi, ọrọhng ka Padan-Aram ọtza ọtzọkha kwanọng kẹ, obiro ọtzọr-ẹ itzọhng bi, “Kwanọng kw'ofon Kenaan kàtzọkha o.”
Obiro oronga bi, Jekọb okk'atzim p'otte ọmaana p'ọkka ọbhaanga, ochina ka Padan-Aram.
Wa Ẹsau on-otzin bi, panọng pa Kenaan bẹ otte Isaak kadaakhi.
Mando kw'Ẹsau obin ochina k'Ishimayẹl, ọtza ọtzọkha kwanọng ọdọdọk kw'okpen Mahalat, kw'ode ọgbaanọkka kw'ikwanọng kwa Nẹbayọt, kw'obiro ode nnwa kw'Ishimayẹl, kw'ode nnwa kw'Abraham.
Jekọb ọttaar idachen ka Bẹtẹl
Mada Jekọb obin ka Bẹrshẹba, ochina ka Haran.
Okwu opyiri k'ibe rani, ọtzọkha ọtza oji, oyima ọnana eho mẹ ọttaabha, okhuri da erungi ẹkk'ẹpya.
Wa ọttaara idachen s'ore ọgbaakha kw'ottim ttẹwọr k'irerek, maa ebir-ebir ọttọhmi k'ọrọngkpakpa, obiro ore da arenga-eden p'Ibinọkpaabyi am-arenga m'ọgbaakha nwuma avura, abira am-arenga ahakha.
Obiro ore da Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obe k'ebir-ebir kw'ọgbaakha nwa oben bi, “Kaam wọ nde Ibinọkpaabyi kw'abatte, Abraham ttara Isaak akpobh. Kaam ńnang kọ ọmaana va pa va pọ irerek nnuma s'ayim mẹ.

Va pa va pọ áhaabh akher oyeyeng kw'irerek, bẹ abira anyaami k'ibe kpenamkpen, kẹ da ewuchen em-eyin, ttara kẹ da ewuchen em-edimi, ọmaana k'ebira-ebira ttara k'ẹrakha-ẹrakha. Orenga ma kọ ttara va pa va pọ, ọyagbin biphyir, ọkhaama ẹdaa.
Kaam ńwobha ttar-ọ, mbiri ḿbaabh-ọ, k'ibe kpenamkpen s'áchina, ḿbiri ndim-ọ mkpa nnam m'irek nna. Kaam kọ ọbọhk kintte maa, nsi ẹjaakhi m'odik nwa kwa nkk'nchekhi nnang-ọ.”
Mada Jekọb ọphyọbh k'ọda, oben bi, “K'odik-ọkkakka, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi owobh m'ibe nna, yina, kaam ira kinnong.”
Wa opoma ọsẹ-ẹ, on-oben bi, “Bọng ibe rọ ijor manda! Ibe nna idọdọk kifha ide iyongi ọhọhm kw'Ibinọkpaabyi; ma wọ ode ẹbaakhamma ch'ọvaarbhon kw'Ibinọkpaabyi.”
K'ekpekpebha ch'ewu ehobh, Jekọb otzini ọtza nwuma kw'ira oyim ọnana eho, ọfhẹ-ẹ iduduma k'irerek, ọtzọkha ana obyengi m'ọtza nwuma.
Kaambi ode bi iwa obhon nwa ochi eden okpena Luz, wa Jekọb on-oyer-ẹ Bẹtẹl.
Iwa Jekọb osi echekhi k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, oben bi, “M'orenga nwa kwa nda ma, idikha Ibinọkpaabyi owobh ttar-m, okker-m, ọnang-m ọchattọhk fa nchi, ọmaana ọbara fa mfọra,
maa ikhina ngwuna k'otte kwaam k'ọhọhm k'odidiri, kẹ Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi wọ óde Ibinọkpaabyi kwa kaam ḿkpobha.
Ọtza nwa kwa nkk'mfha mach'ekpọmmachi, óde ọhọhm kw'Ibinọkpaabyi. Ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'anang-m, kaam mbiri ńkkema fẹ k'obe jobh, ńdọkha rani nnang-ọ.”
